page.title: Richard Chute, data analysis and pipelines
page.description: Analyst and pipeline builder in Fort Lauderdale. Postgres, Python and applied modelling, with fifteen years of running the operations the numbers describe.

name: Richard Chute
lede: Data pipelines and analysis people decide from.

ways.label: Append-only data
ways.title: Append-only data
ways.body: Never drop, never truncate. Upsert and keep the history. A silent corruption costs more than a crash, because a crash tells you.

ways.label: Modelled is labelled
ways.title: Modelled is labelled modelled
ways.body: A metric that did not exist in an era reads "not measured", never zero-filled to look observed. A chart that reads well but overstates what was measured is a defect, not a rough edge.

ways.label: Instruments, not tables
ways.title: The output is an instrument, not a table
ways.body:
The deliverable is not the number. It is the thing someone opens, reads and decides from.

The notebooks are published with their saved outputs, charts and tables only; the code behind them stays private.
